correctness.rationale: Geometric orbit triangulation and exact quotient edges give the right topological invariant. The bundled independent original-face checks and matrix verifier reproduce these identities. Cauchy-Hadamard and a zero-free unit circle prove nonperiodicity and exponential limsup. No unsupported inference from sample checks is made.

value.rationale: The natural width-two hexagonal strip family has known nonequivariant topology but symmetry-sensitive Lefschetz values are not determined by it. This theorem supplies all length values by a short and nonperiodic order-four recurrence, exhibits exponential limsup growth unlike related periodic reflection families, and gives an exact PL fixed-space orbit construction. It is a motivated topological character invariant, not an arbitrary finite count.
